articles.title: Bitcoin rallies after Japan rate increase with XLM, INJ, UNI advancing
articles.snippet: Stellar’s XLM, Injective’s INJ and Uniswap’s UNI ranked among the best performers in the 100 biggest cryptocurrencies by market capitalization.

articles.title: AI Agents Still Can't Stop Prompt Injection Attacks, Researchers Warn
articles.snippet: A new benchmark study found AI agents remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks as companies increasingly roll out the technology to the public.
